rationale: The Latin anchor *prosternere* means "to throw/stretch down flat," directly matching prostrate.v.03 ("throw down flat, as on the ground"). The attestation at Mt. 2:11 (the Magi falling prostrate in worship) confirms a physical, concrete act of throwing oneself flat, rather than a metaphorical rendering helpless (v.02) or the intransitive positional sense (v.01).
